tagline: The sky above you, decoded by you, shared with the world.

tiles.adsb: Every airliner broadcasts where it is. Here is what it says, and why anyone can listen.
tiles.build: A Raspberry Pi, a USB radio stick and a small antenna: about an hour, and the sky is yours.
tiles.join: Share what your receiver hears with ADSB Exchange, FlightAware, Flightradar24 and Plane Finder.
tiles.zenithboard: The wall of dots or the split-flap board, the console, the posts on Bluesky. One command installs it.
tiles.faq: Range, obstacles, Wi-Fi, 1 GB of memory: the questions people ask, with honest answers.
tiles.about: Who makes this, the licences, and how to say thank you.

colour_hint: The wall's colour, kept in this browser only. No cookie.
beer_text: ZenithBoard is free and its code is public. A beer says thank you; it unlocks nothing and helps pay for the electricity.
